content.thinking: My generator bug again: `bucket=[rng.randint(1,3), rng.randint(0,3)]` can produce I > B. Let me fix: I = rng.randint(0, B).

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
src=open('tools/runtests4.py').read()
src=src.replace("'bucket': [rng.randint(1, 3), rng.randint(0, 3)]","'bucket': [1, 0]")
src=src.replace("    slots = [[t, rng.randint(0, 4), 0 if i == 0 else rng.randint(0, 4)] for i, t in enumerate(times)]",
"    bcap = rng.randint(1, 3)\n    slots = [[t, rng.randint(0, 4), 0 if i == 0 else rng.randint(0, 4)] for i, t in enumerate(times)]")
src=src.replace("'bucket': [1, 0]","'bucket': [bcap, rng.randint(0, bcap)]")
open('tools/runtests4.py','w').write(src)
EOF
cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native timeout -s KILL 1500 python3 -Bu tools/runtests4.py 400 81 2>&1 | tail -4
